facts.fact: 新婚夜他转身，脸上带着难以形容的表情，抬起手环住她的喉咙，但没有吻她。
facts.anchor: He was as closed off from me as I had ever seen him. He looked at me almost dispassionately, and raised a hand to rest around my throat.

facts.fact: 她睁开眼时，他像看怪物一样看她，惊恐地后退。
facts.anchor: When I opened my eyes, he was staring at me with something like horror on his face. He looked at me as though I were a monster of sorts

facts.fact: 她以为自己与他精神相连，不再孤身走世界的解脱感巨大。
facts.anchor: I had presumed we were together in spirit as well as on paper and the relief of no longer walking the world alone had been immense

facts.fact: 早餐时他把昨夜的行为解释为突然的胃病，但她心里知道不是。
facts.anchor: I think I may have caught some sort of awful stomach bug. I behaved atrociously last night, I know.

facts.fact: 花园里他摘了一个红苹果递给她，像递一枚新的结婚戒指；她没道谢放进口袋。
facts.anchor: We circled the apple trees, bursting with life, and he reached up with ease and plucked a perfect red apple, which he handed me, as though he was handing me a new wedding ring.

facts.fact: 她把一废一活两座喷泉的并置视为 S— House 的完美写照。
facts.anchor: The juxtaposition of the disused, neglected fountain, next to one that flowed so freely, the water glistening in the morning light, perfectly encompassed S— House.

facts.fact: 她原谅他是因为爱和希望，而这份希望最终把她封进棺材。
facts.anchor: It was this hope, stupid and selfish, that sealed me in my coffin in the end.

facts.fact: 结尾揭示他们曾有孩子，孩子仍住在 S— House 的走廊里，而 Alexander 早已离世。
facts.anchor: The proof is in the life coursing through my veins, still haunting the halls of his home, while he is long gone.
